description: This file contains the PHP source code defining the 'Bestseller' class within the OpenCart ecommerce platform. The class extends the product model and provides functionality to retrieve best-selling products based on a specified limit, including caching and SQL query construction.

classes.name: Bestseller
classes.description: A class that provides methods to fetch best-selling products from the database, extending the core product model.

methods.name: getBestSellers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of best-selling products limited by the given number, utilizing caching to optimize repeated queries.
